WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT 
    p.fundflux,
    AVG(ss.boxy / ss.boxz) as y_z_avg,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM scanspatial ss
  JOIN projects p ON ss.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
avg_counts AS (
  SELECT AVG(cnt) as avg_cnt FROM grouped
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    g.y_z_avg,
    g.cnt,
    g.cnt - a.avg_cnt as diff
  FROM grouped g
  CROSS JOIN avg_counts a
  WHERE a.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL AND g.cnt > a.avg_cnt
)
SELECT 
  AVG(y_z_avg) as avg_y_z,
  SUM(cnt) as total_cnt,
  AVG(diff) as avg_diff
FROM filtered
